title: Kepler Reach Rising Again
author: Emrys Delacroix
blurb: Lior Crane, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
